description: This file contains API client functions for authentication-related operations, including fetching user organizations by email and logging in with email and password. It imports configuration, utility functions, and URL resolution helpers, and exports functions that perform network requests to authentication endpoints.

methods.name: fetchUserOrganizationsByEmail
methods.description: Fetches organizations associated with a given email address by calling the API endpoint and handling the response.

methods.name: loginWithOrgEmailPassword
methods.description: Performs login using email and password, validates tenant salt, constructs request payload, handles response, and returns authentication token and payload.
